reasoning: 驗證目標：在交通頻道播送播放模式中再次按下 Traffic & Weather 鍵時，回到先前的頻道。為什麼這樣切：條款的判準是回到「先前」那一台而非任意台，故前置條件記下出發頻道並以其身分比對；同時要求該次返回不改變其他狀態（仍為衛星音訊來源）。與 151 的差別：該 leaf 驗整趟往返這項能力，本 leaf 驗回程這一段的觸發與目標（§8.2.1）。[A-SX03]。

tcs.tc_title: A second activation returns to the channel played before the jump
tcs.test_item: If the Traffic & Weather button is activated again while in traffic channel broadcast play mode, the HU shall return to the previous channel
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. A traffic city ID is set and its latest broadcast is available
5. The channel tuned before the jump is recorded and is not the traffic and weather channel
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Activate the Traffic & Weather button and read the tuned channel
2. While the traffic and weather broadcast is playing, activate the Traffic & Weather button again
3. Read the tuned channel and the selected source
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned channel is the traffic and weather channel and its broadcast is playing
2. The activation is accepted
3. The tuned channel is the channel recorded in the pre-conditions and the HU Satellite Audio source is still selected
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
